Class Epidemic

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Epidemic
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardInterface, Serializable
public class Epidemic extends Card implements Serializable
Class that manages the single card epidemic Every trucker has to remove a crew member from each occupied cabin that is connected to another occupied cabin
